sources.snippet: faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This implementation is up to 4 times faster than openai/whisper for the same accuracy while using less memory. The efficiency can be further improved with 8-bit quantization on both CPU and GPU.

sources.title: Faster Whisper - Fast and Accurate AI Speech-to-Text Software
sources.snippet: About the software What is Faster Whisper? Faster Whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using the high-performance CTranslate2 runtime. It delivers the same trusted speech-to-text accuracy while running dramatically faster and lighter — making professional transcription possible on everyday hardware.
